BasicAuth.description:
Credentials for a remote that requires them: a git host, a WebDAV server.

The username is usually a literal -- GitHub wants ``x-access-token`` -- so
it takes one. But a service account's name arrives in the same secret as
its password, and writing it out here as well is how the two drift apart
the day the account is recreated, so it takes an ``{env:}`` reference too.
BasicAuth.title: BasicAuth

DeliverySettings.description:
The config's defaults for the delivery inputs: None leaves the built-in one.

Each is a lax string, and ``max`` may be a whole number too, checked when the server
is built: a value its input doesn't take is warned once and ignored, and the next
level answers.

resources.description: Whether the client reads resources, on, or takes them as tools, off.
resources.title: Resources

listed.description: What resources/list shows, a comma string of skills, prompts and agents.
listed.title: Listed

via.description: How the client takes the plugins: mcp, extension or local.
via.title: Via

max.description: How many skills a listing shows, a whole number or all for no cap; it counts skills only.
max.title: Max

DeliverySettings.title: DeliverySettings

EnvRef.description: A secret named by the environment variable that holds it.
EnvRef.title: EnvRef

LibraryConfig.description:
A library: a marketplace, plugins by name, or a query -- and their union.

A library carries no tags. Tagging is what a plugin does, so ``?tag=``
reaches a library only through what its plugins say, and the selector gets
an unambiguous name of its own after Kubernetes' ``selector``. Its
``categories`` label it for a category scope alone: they are not any
plugin's category, so a ``pluginSelector`` never reads them.

categories.description: The library's categories: a category scope selects every library that lists one.
categories.title: Categories

LibraryConfig.title: LibraryConfig

PluginConfig.description:
A folder of skills and prompts: a path under a source, plus its metadata.

The metadata fields are Claude's marketplace-entry fields, so a plugin
declared here and one read out of a ``marketplace.json`` carry the same
shape and a selector cannot tell them apart. ``prompts`` and ``files``
are this server's own glob lists: omitted, a kind is the conventions and
the plugin's own ``plugin.json`` and entry, merged per kind as Claude Code
merges them. ``skills`` lists folders, added to ``skills/`` as Claude
Code adds a manifest's.

skills.description: Folders, not globs: each is a skill, or holds skills one level down, and adds to the skills/ folder every plugin is read from. [] serves no skill.
skills.title: Skills

PluginConfig.title: PluginConfig

Selector.description:
A query over plugins: categories narrow first, then tag groups.

Across the two fields it is AND, as in every faceted search. Within
``categories`` it can only be OR -- a plugin has exactly one category --
and within ``tags`` a comma means *all of* while separate items mean *any
of*, which is the same comma rule a request's ``?tag=`` carries.
Selector.title: Selector

Serving.description:
How kb serves: kubed-mcp's ``serving`` section, with kb's defaults.

kb serves ``http`` on every address by default, as a container does, and
serves ``stdio`` or ``http`` alone: ``sse`` and ``streamable-http`` are a
config error. ``port``, ``log_level`` and ``graceful_timeout`` are
kubed-mcp's as they are.

transport.description: The transport kb serves on: http or stdio.
transport.title: Transport

host.description: The address the http transport binds.
host.title: Host

port.description: The port an HTTP transport listens on.
port.title: Port

log_level.description: The root logger's level, set when the server runs.
log_level.title: Log Level

graceful_timeout.description: Seconds in-flight HTTP requests get to finish when the server stops; a stop by signal ends listen streams at once, a programmatic stop waits up to graceful_timeout for them. stdio doesn't read it.
graceful_timeout.title: Graceful Timeout

Serving.title: Serving

SourceConfig.description: A named backend: where bytes come from and how to log in, declared once.
SourceConfig.title: SourceConfig

Telemetry.description:
What the process reports: kubed-mcp's ``telemetry`` section, profiles,
traces and metrics, with kb's one guard on the profiles address. Absent,
every signal is off.

profiles.description: Pyroscope server address; setting it turns profiles on.
profiles.title: Profiles

profile_cpu.description: Sample CPU while profiles are on.
profile_cpu.title: Profile Cpu

profile_memory.description: Sample allocations while profiles are on.
profile_memory.title: Profile Memory

otel.description: Run OpenTelemetry, configured by the standard OTEL_* variables.
otel.title: Otel

tags.description: Labels on every profile, and resource attributes on every trace and metric.
tags.title: Tags

Telemetry.title: Telemetry

sources.description: Backends, named once: where bytes come from and how to log in.
sources.title: Sources

plugins.description: Folders of skills, agents and prompts under a source.
plugins.title: Plugins

libraries.description: Saved queries over plugins: the first segment of every address served.
libraries.title: Libraries

cache_dir.description: Where a non-file:// source materialises, and where index.json lives.
cache_dir.title: Cache Dir
